description: Toybox 10K picture props for grade 1 phonics words (ENGINE_REQUESTS #81): one recognisable object per word so a picture card shows the word without spelling it. See catalog/asset_map.json for word -> prop. Generated by tools/gen_tk_phonics.mjs: edit the generator and rerun it, not the JSON.

push_pin.description: A push pin (pin): a round red head on a short silver point, standing point down, 0.8 m tall. For the short-i word pin.

zipper.description: A zipper (zip) on a strip of blue cloth: gold teeth up the middle, the slider and its pull tab near the top (named part `pull`: move it down to unzip). For the short-i word zip.

wig.description: A curly wig on a round grey stand: a puffy cap of bouncy curls in its main colour (yellow), 0.9 m tall. For the short-i word wig.

bib.description: A baby's bib: a rounded cloth in its main colour (sky blue) with a white trim, a neck hole and two ties, a yellow duck on the front, 0.8 m tall, standing upright facing the camera. For the short-i word bib.

mop.description: A floor mop standing up: a wooden handle and a big fluffy head of cream strings on the floor, 1.1 m tall. For the short-o word mop.

spinning_top.description: A toy spinning top on its point: a striped round body (red and yellow), a short handle on top, 0.7 m tall (spin it about y to spin). For the short-o word top.

hand_fan.description: A folding paper fan opened into a half circle: pleats in its main colour (pink) and white, fanning up from a little wooden handle, 1 m wide, facing the camera. For the short-a word fan.

frying_pan.description: A frying pan seen from above, its round face to the camera: a dark pan with a grey cooking surface and a long wooden handle down to the right, 1 m across. For the short-a word pan.

folded_map.description: A folded paper treasure map standing open: three panels with a dotted path, a river, a tree and a red X, 1 m wide. For the short-a word map.

hug_pair.description: Two round toy bears hugging, arms around each other (a hug): one brown, one honey, eyes closed and smiling, 0.9 m tall. For the short-u word hug.

ten_dots.description: Ten red counters in two rows of five on a sky-blue board (a full ten frame), 1.1 m wide: a picture of the number ten without the word.

bubble_gum.description: A big pink bubble-gum bubble blown from a little pink wrapper with a white stripe, 0.8 m tall. For the short-u word gum.

sack.description: A tied burlap sack, plump and soft, with a twine bow at its neck, 0.9 m tall. For the short-a word sack.

ham.description: A cartoon ham on the bone, turned so its pale pink cut face shows: a plump rosy joint and a white bone sticking out to the right, 0.9 m long. For the short-a word ham.

flag.description: A little flag on a pole: a rectangle of cloth in its main colour (red) with a white star, on a wooden pole with a gold ball, 1.2 m tall (wiggle the named part `cloth` to wave it). For the short-a word flag.

clothes_peg.description: A wooden clothes peg (peg), two prongs held by a silver spring, standing up, 0.9 m tall. For the short-e word peg.

pie.description: A round fruit pie seen from above, its face to the camera: a golden crust rim and a criss-cross lattice over red filling, in a white dish, 0.9 m across. For the long-i word pie.

necktie.description: A necktie (tie) in its main colour (blue) with yellow stripes and a knot at the top, hanging straight, 1.1 m tall. For the long-i word tie.

nine_dots.description: Nine counters in three rows of three on a yellow board, 0.9 m wide: a picture of the number nine without the word.

rope_coil.description: A coiled rope (rope) seen from above, face to the camera: a thick rope wound in a flat spiral with one loose end, 1 m across. For the long-o word rope.

nose_face.description: A friendly round face with a big round nose in the middle (point at the named part `nose`), small eyes and a smile, 0.9 m tall. For the long-o word nose.

garden_hose.description: A green garden hose coiled in loops facing the camera, its yellow nozzle spraying a little water, 1 m across. For the long-o word hose.

nail.description: A big shiny nail standing point down: a flat round head on a long shaft, 0.9 m tall. For the long-a word nail.

road_piece.description: A stretch of road going away into the distance, drawn like a picture facing the camera: dark asphalt narrowing toward the top, dashed yellow centre lines, green grass either side, 1 m wide. For the long-o word road.

fluffy_tail.description: A big bushy animal tail (tail) curling up, in its main colour (orange) with a white tip, 1 m tall. For the long-a word tail.

music_note.description: A music note (an eighth note): a round head, a stem and a flag, in its main colour (purple), 1 m tall, facing the camera. For the long-o word note.

huge_ball.description: A huge red ball towering over a tiny blue toy block beside it (huge), 1.2 m tall: size shown by contrast. For the long-u word huge.

flute.description: A shiny silver flute held on a slant, its gold keys along the front, 1 m long. For the long-u word flute.

prune.description: A plump dark purple prune (a dried plum) with a soft shine and a small brown stalk, 0.6 m wide. For the long-u word prune.

ocean_wave.description: An ocean wave curling over with white foam on its crest, 1.2 m wide, from the side. For the long-a word wave (the sea's wave; hand_wave is a waving hand).

hand_wave.description: A friendly open hand waving hello (wave): palm to the camera, fingers spread, little motion lines beside it, 0.9 m tall. Wiggle the named part `hand` to wave.

board_game.description: A board game ready to play, its board facing the camera: a winding path of coloured squares round the edge, two counters and a white die in front, 1 m across. For the long-a word game.

fig.description: A ripe fig: a plump purple teardrop with a short stalk and a cut half beside it showing pink seedy flesh, 0.5 m. For the short-i word fig.

finger_poke.description: A hand with one finger poking forward (a jab, a quick poke): a fist with the pointing finger out to the right and little motion lines, 0.6 m. For the short-a word jab.

door_knock.description: A fist rapping on a wooden door (rap: knock knock): a door panel with a knocker plate and a small fist at it, curved knock lines beside, 0.9 m tall. For the short-a word rap.

wedding_rings.description: Two shiny gold wedding rings linked together with a little heart above them (wed), 0.5 m wide. For the short-e word wed.

fishing_rod.description: A fishing rod held on a slant: a long wooden rod with a reel, a line hanging from its tip and a red-and-white float, 1.2 m. For the short-o word rod.

glum_face.description: A glum face (sad and fed up): a round face in its main colour with droopy eyes under flat brows and a down-turned mouth, 0.8 m. For the short-u word glum.

plop_splash.description: A plop: a fat water drop landing in a puddle with a little crown splash and ripples, 0.7 m. For the short-o word plop.
